mapper.select: SELECT count(*)::integer AS "totalPeople", count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m WHERE m.DEV_ID=d.DEV_ID AND m.INPUT_YM=#{month} AND m.MON_MM > 0 ))::integer AS "assignedPeople" FROM TB_HR_DEV d WHERE d.DRCT_CLS_CD='DRCT' AND (d.JNCMP_DT IS NULL OR d.JNCMP_DT <= #{last}) AND (d.RETIRE_DT IS NULL OR d.RETIRE_DT >= #{first})
